text:
Store namespaced documents and retrieve evidence by keyword, meaning or both. Start with free capabilities, then configure prompts and upsert records with their source path.
upsert (JSON only): Classify and embed one sourced record, then publish its new revision. Provider failure changes no record; a first namespace binding can remain empty.; returns: Full record JSON, <=256 KiB with reconstructed embeddings and derived classification_ids(label->probability). Omitting key1/key2 clears them. Worst-case escaped-source, label and float32-vector budgets are refused before any paid call.
get (JSON only): Get one record in the required namespace; a missing or foreign-namespace id answers not_found.
list (JSON only): Browse record summaries in stable order, up to 16 per call; send the returned cursor for the next page.; returns: JSON {records:[summaries],cursor:string|null}; <=16 summaries, excluding data and embeddings, each <=32 KiB. Filters do not grant access; no snapshot guarantee across calls.
search (JSON only): Retrieve live evidence in the requested mode and namespace, one best chunk per record. Keyword is the free default; semantic and hybrid use the bound embedding model.; returns: JSON with effective mode and live citations: namespace, tableName, id, chunk_index, source, content_hash, excerpt, scores, indexed_at. scores contains bm25 (keyword), dense (semantic) or rrf (hybrid); no component scores are invented. With rerank:true, one paid Voyage rerank call reorders the query's candidates and adds a rerank score; reranked:true says it did, reranked:false with rerank_failure keeps the unreranked order. No generation or historical revision retrieval.
count (JSON only): Count live records matching a filter and how many carry each label; free.; returns: JSON {count, labels:{label:records}, labels_truncated}; labels holds at most 64 labels, most frequent first, and labels_truncated:true says more exist. Deleted records are not counted.
similar (JSON only): Find live records whose stored vectors are nearest a given record's, in the same table and namespace; free, nothing is embedded.; returns: JSON {records:[citations]} like search, one best chunk per record, excluding the given record; scores contains similarity. A missing or deleted record answers not_found.
classify (JSON only): Label a text with the table's classification prompts as upsert would, without storing it; one paid #ai call, off unless the classify setting is true.; returns: JSON {labels:{label:probability}, probabilities:{label:probability}}: labels keeps those at or above the table's threshold, at most top_k; probabilities holds every label. With classify off it is refused as classify_unavailable before any call.
keyword_index (JSON only): Build only the selected namespace's keyword index. Owner or Maintainers only; collection vector provisioning remains a shared infrastructure action.; returns: JSON {status:"ok",indexed:n} when every chunk has its words (n counts this run), or "incomplete: ..." to repeat. If the Qdrant proxy refuses to add the vector, the answer names the owner's one-time command.; role: owner|maintainer
[destructive] delete (JSON only): Remove one record, or exactly the namespace-scoped selection you name.; returns: JSON {status:"ok"}, without a count; a missing id answers not_found. id requires tableName and forbids key1/key2/all; otherwise all:true is required. Deletes selected revisions, never prompt KV. A retained tombstone allows explicit cleanup continuation; unknown outcomes never retry themselves.
[destructive] prompts (JSON only): Read, replace or delete one table's classification prompts; existing records stay as they are.
capabilities (JSON only): Read static app version, methods, modes, limits and configured embedding model, even before configuration. Namespace-free; no storage or paid call and no health claim.
namespaces (JSON only): List known namespace names and exact live-record counts, including empty namespaces. Owner or Maintainers only; no record content. This metadata discovery is namespace-free.; returns: JSON {namespaces:[{namespace,count}],cursor:string|null}; a failed count refuses rather than inventing zero.; role: owner|maintainer
[destructive] drop_namespace (JSON only): Remove one namespace's records, prompts and binding. Owner or Maintainers only, with confirm equal to namespace. A partial or uncertain drop stays blocked until an explicitly confirmed continuation; never retried automatically.; returns: JSON {status:"dropped"|"absent",namespace:string}; another namespace and the shared collection stay unchanged. An absent binding with existing data refuses as legacy_data.; role: owner|maintainer

Examples
agent-bus call '#rag@node.example' '{"method":"upsert","namespace":"team","tableName":"notes","id":"tea","data":"Tea is a drink.","source":"notes/tea.md"}'
agent-bus call '#rag@node.example' '{"method":"get","namespace":"team","tableName":"notes","id":"tea"}'
agent-bus call '#rag@node.example' '{"method":"list","namespace":"team","tableName":"notes","limit":2}'
agent-bus call '#rag@node.example' '{"method":"search","namespace":"team","query":"green tea","limit":5}'
agent-bus call '#rag@node.example' '{"method":"count","namespace":"team","tableName":"notes"}'
agent-bus call '#rag@node.example' '{"method":"similar","namespace":"team","tableName":"notes","id":"tea","limit":5}'
agent-bus call '#rag@node.example' '{"method":"classify","namespace":"team","tableName":"notes","data":"Green tea with lemon."}'
agent-bus call '#rag@node.example' --wait=120s '{"method":"keyword_index","namespace":"team"}'
agent-bus call '#rag@node.example' '{"method":"delete","namespace":"team","tableName":"notes","id":"tea"}'
agent-bus call '#rag@node.example' '{"method":"prompts","action":"set","namespace":"team","tableName":"notes","data":{"labels":{"drink":"Beverages","other":"Other topics"},"instructions":"Choose the topic."}}'
agent-bus call '#rag@node.example' '{"method":"capabilities"}'
agent-bus call '#rag@node.example' '{"method":"namespaces"}'
agent-bus call '#rag@node.example' '{"method":"drop_namespace","namespace":"team","confirm":"team"}'

json.description: Store namespaced documents and retrieve evidence by keyword, meaning or both. Start with free capabilities, then configure prompts and upsert records with their source path.
json.author: Sergey Porfiriev

upsert.help: Classify and embed one sourced record, then publish its new revision. Provider failure changes no record; a first namespace binding can remain empty.

args.help: Required explicit namespace for every data method, prompts and keyword_index; no default or wildcard. UTF-8 NFC, 1..128 bytes, no BOM, NUL or newline.
args.name: namespace

args.help: UTF-8 table name, 1..128 bytes; required for upsert/get/prompts, optional filter for list/delete. A table alone is never sufficient. All identity/filter strings must already be NFC; no aliases or silent normalization. Same byte, BOM/NUL/newline and non-blank rules as namespace.
args.name: tableName

args.help: Exact record ID, 1..128 UTF-8 bytes; strings only, no numeric coercion. All identity/filter strings must already be NFC; no aliases or silent normalization.
args.name: id

args.help: UTF-8 source, at most 32768 bytes; no BOM, NUL or invalid encoding. For application/json, supply JSON text. The source cap is an upper bound: whitespace break points can require more than 8 chunks and refuse early.
args.name: data

args.help: Required source path or URI as provenance data, not a path RAG opens. At most 2048 UTF-8 bytes, NFC, non-blank, no BOM, NUL or newline.
args.name: source

args.help: Optional exact filter value, at most 256 UTF-8 bytes; null is refused and never silently omitted. All identity/filter strings must already be NFC; no aliases or silent normalization. Empty string is valid; omission in upsert clears it.
args.name: key1

args.help: Optional exact filter value, at most 256 UTF-8 bytes; null is refused and never silently omitted. All identity/filter strings must already be NFC; no aliases or silent normalization. Empty string is valid; omission in upsert clears it.
args.name: key2

args.help: Content type; HTML excludes script/style, Markdown keeps its source, JSON is canonicalized for chunking.
args.name: mime-type

args.help: Optional array of vectors aligned with deterministic chunks, <=8 vectors and <=8192 total scalars. Each has configured dimensions; finite float32-range numbers only, no booleans. Storage round-trips float32; omission calls Voyage. Get returns reconstructed vectors; list omits them.
args.name: embeddings

args.help: Optional lower-case SHA256 of exact submitted data UTF-8 bytes; a mismatch refuses before provider work. Computed when omitted.
args.name: content_hash

upsert.returns: Full record JSON, <=256 KiB with reconstructed embeddings and derived classification_ids(label->probability). Omitting key1/key2 clears them. Worst-case escaped-source, label and float32-vector budgets are refused before any paid call.

args.help: For set only: object with labels (1..64 IDs, at most 128 bytes each, mapped to descriptions <=512 bytes), instructions (1..4096 UTF-8 bytes), optional threshold (finite 0..1, default 0.5), top_k (integer 1..64, default 5), summary (<=4096 UTF-8 bytes, stored for R.9). qdrant.help: Complete Qdrant proxy bus name; this app needs its own write grant

voyage.help: Complete embedding proxy bus name; this app needs its own allow grant

ai.help: Complete Decisions proxy bus name; this app needs its own allow grant

collection.help: Owner-created dedicated collection, 1..64 ASCII letters, digits, underscore or hyphen; never auto-created

embedding_model.help: Fixed embedding model ID, verified against collection metadata.embedding_model

dimensions.help: Fixed unnamed Cosine vector size, 1..8192; chunks times dimensions must not exceed 8192 Must also be an output dimension the chosen Voyage model supports; its refusal is not bypassed.

decision_model.help: Model for one Jev Choice call per record

keyword_search.help: Keyword search engine for search: builtin (default) uses the collection's BM25 sparse vector named text; external answers through an engine connected to the agent, and builtin ingest is then off

rerank_model.help: Voyage rerank model for search with rerank:true; empty (default) turns rerank off and such a search is refused as rerank_unavailable

classify.help: true turns on classify, which makes one paid #ai Jev call per request with decision_model; false (default) refuses classify as classify_unavailable
